about: Golden vectors for backup import (plan + merge), generated from :shared Kotlin by PortabilityGoldenTest (androidHostTest). Do not edit by hand. `backup` is the file every case reads; each case is a device (profiles, domain rows, optional replica) and the user's choices. Ratings are 0..10 doubles; rows are listed sorted. The merge label for kept-both reviews is "<deviceName> · yyyy-MM-dd" (UTC) of exportedAt.
